source_classification: Analytically prescribed optically thin line emission in arbitrary flux units; no galaxy, mass map, gravity field or observed covariance.

primary_references.equations: Appendix A, equation A11: v_los = sin(i) [v_R sin(psi) + v_phi cos(psi)]; A23 documents geometry/kinematic harmonic confusion. Only the projection identity is implemented, not epicycle dynamics.

Sections 2.1-2.2: emitting tilted rings, Gaussian line profiles and spatial convolution; equation 1: Gaussian beam. This is an independent restricted mechanics implementation, not a reproduction of the full 3DBarolo package.

missing_closures: observed source conversion, geometry and covariance

quadrature.truth_method: independent Gauss-Legendre radius, staggered periodic azimuth, rotation matrices, scipy ndtr and direct spatial convolution

study.covariance: Supplied positive diagonal covariance: sigma[c,y,x]=noise_sigma_flux*(1+0.15*cos(2*pi*c/nc))*(1+0.1*x/(nx-1)); independent noise between every voxel. No estimated or astronomical covariance.
study.split: Fixed by indices before generation. Training: c%3!=0 and (x+2*y)%3!=0. Held-out channels: c%3==0 at training pixels. Held-out pixels: held-out spatial pixels at training channels. Joint: both held-out. All cells retained, no signal-selected masks.
study.fit: Bounded scipy least_squares, two fixed starts, maximum 100 function evaluations per start, select by training weighted sum of squares only. Parameters scaled by bound width. Geometry/source radial shape/center/total flux fixed except enumerated parameters.
study.expanded_predictive_recovery_criterion: Descriptive only: every held-out split has noise-weighted squared residual per voxel <=1.25 AND truth-mean weighted squared error per voxel <=0.25. Failure retained; no benchmark gate depends on achieving recovery or fitted parameter accuracy.

independent_controls: Cartesian rotation-matrix projection versus scalar formula
face-on, edge-on, rotation/radial sign and rigid-rotation limits
analytic truncated exponential integrated flux and independent Gaussian CDF
independent direct cube quadrature with different nodes
narrow-band losses and cropped beam flux transport including outside-FOV in-scatter
face-on full-cube and unresolved-spectrum rotation/radial degeneracies

access_accounting.freeze_requirement: Write config hash and primary references before implementation and synthetic response generation; pass all numerical gates before injection study.
